products.title: Centrifugal Pump CP-200
products.excerpt: End-suction pump for clean water and cooling circuits, up to 200 m³/h.
products.specs:
Flow rate: 200 m³/h
Head: 45 m
Motor: 37 kW, 400 V
Max temperature: 90 °C
Casing: cast iron
products.body:
The CP-200 is our most requested pump for cooling towers and process water. A back pull-out design lets your crew replace the seal without touching the pipework.

Typical applications

  • Cooling water circuits
  • Irrigation and transfer
  • Fire-water boost

Supplied with a mechanical seal, coupling guard and baseplate. Bronze or stainless impellers on request.

products.title: Inline Pump IP-80
products.excerpt: Space-saving inline pump for HVAC and booster sets.
products.specs:
Flow rate: 80 m³/h
Head: 32 m
Motor: 11 kW, 400 V
Max temperature: 110 °C
Casing: ductile iron
products.body:
Inline flanges mean the IP-80 drops straight into an existing pipe run. Most of our installs replace an older pump in under a day.

Available with an integrated variable speed drive for constant-pressure control.

products.title: Multistage Pump MS-40
products.excerpt: Vertical multistage pump for high-pressure washing and boiler feed.
products.specs:
Flow rate: 40 m³/h
Head: 160 m
Motor: 30 kW, 400 V
Stages: 8
Material: stainless steel 316
products.body: Stack the stages you need and nothing more. The MS-40 covers boiler feed, reverse osmosis and wash-down duties where pressure matters more than volume.

products.title: Self-Priming Pump SP-50
products.excerpt: Self-priming pump for sumps, tanks and dewatering.
products.specs:
Flow rate: 50 m³/h
Head: 25 m
Suction lift: 7.5 m
Motor: 7.5 kW, 400 V
Solids: up to 38 mm
products.body: No foot valve, no priming routine. The SP-50 re-primes itself after the tank runs dry, which is why rental fleets like it.

products.title: Chemical Pump CX-25
products.excerpt: Magnetic-drive pump for acids and solvents, no shaft seal to leak.
products.specs:
Flow rate: 25 m³/h
Head: 30 m
Drive: magnetic coupling
Material: PVDF
Max temperature: 80 °C
products.body: The CX-25 has no dynamic seal at all: the impeller is driven through the casing by a magnetic coupling. For hydrochloric acid, sodium hypochlorite and most solvents this is the safest option we sell.

products.title: Gear Pump GP-15
products.excerpt: Internal gear pump for oils, resins and syrups.
products.specs:
Flow rate: 15 m³/h
Pressure: 10 bar
Viscosity: up to 100,000 cP
Motor: 5.5 kW
Material: cast iron
products.body: Thick products need a pump that does not care about viscosity. The GP-15 moves lube oil, glucose and resins at a steady rate with a built-in relief valve.

products.title: High-Temp Gear Pump GT-350 °C
products.excerpt: Jacketed gear pump for bitumen and thermal oil up to 350 °C.
products.specs:
Flow rate: 12 m³/h
Pressure: 8 bar
Max temperature: 350 °C
Jacket: thermal oil
Material: carbon steel
products.body: Asphalt plants and thermal-oil heaters run this pump all season. The heating jacket keeps product liquid at start-up, so there is no cold-start damage.

products.title: Lobe Pump LP-10
products.excerpt: Hygienic lobe pump for food and dairy, clean-in-place ready.
products.specs:
Flow rate: 10 m³/h
Pressure: 12 bar
Finish: Ra 0.8 µm
Material: stainless steel 316L
Certification: EHEDG
products.body: Gentle on yoghurt, sauces and anything with soft particles. The LP-10 strips down without tools for inspection.

products.title: Air-Operated Diaphragm Pump DP-2
products.excerpt: 2-inch air-operated double diaphragm pump, runs dry without damage.
products.specs:
Flow rate: 37 m³/h
Air pressure: 8 bar
Port size: 2 in
Body: aluminium
Diaphragms: PTFE
products.body: No electricity at the point of use, so the DP-2 suits hazardous areas, slurries and drum transfer.

products.title: Dosing Pump DZ-1
products.excerpt: Digital dosing pump for water treatment chemicals.
products.specs:
Flow rate: 7.5 l/h
Pressure: 16 bar
Control: 4-20 mA / pulse
Head: PVDF
Accuracy: ±1%
products.body: Chlorine, coagulants, pH correction: the DZ-1 doses to the millilitre and logs every stroke.

products.title: Rotary Screw Compressor RS-37
products.excerpt: 37 kW oil-injected screw compressor for continuous plant air.
products.specs:
Free air delivery: 6.2 m³/min
Pressure: 8 bar
Motor: 37 kW
Noise: 68 dB(A)
Cooling: air
products.body: The workhorse of a typical workshop. Belt-free direct drive, a controller with remote monitoring and service every 4,000 hours.

products.title: Variable Speed Compressor VS-22
products.excerpt: Variable speed screw compressor that follows your air demand.
products.specs:
Free air delivery: 1.1–3.9 m³/min
Pressure: 5.5–10 bar
Motor: 22 kW VSD
Noise: 65 dB(A)
Energy saving: up to 35%
products.body: If your demand swings through the shift, a fixed-speed machine wastes energy idling. The VS-22 slows down instead.

products.title: Oil-Free Compressor OF-15
products.excerpt: Class 0 oil-free air for food, pharma and electronics.
products.specs:
Free air delivery: 1.8 m³/min
Pressure: 8 bar
Air quality: ISO 8573-1 Class 0
Motor: 15 kW
Cooling: air
products.body: No oil in the compression chamber, so there is nothing to carry over into your product.

products.title: Piston Compressor PC-7
products.excerpt: Two-stage piston compressor for garages and small workshops.
products.specs:
Free air delivery: 0.9 m³/min
Pressure: 11 bar
Motor: 7.5 kW
Receiver: 500 l
Duty: intermittent
products.body: Simple, rebuildable and still the cheapest air per dollar for intermittent use.

products.title: Refrigerated Air Dryer RD-60
products.excerpt: Refrigerated dryer for 6 m³/min, dew point +3 °C.
products.specs:
Capacity: 6 m³/min
Dew point: +3 °C
Refrigerant: R513A
Power: 1.1 kW
Drain: zero-loss
products.body: Wet air rusts pipework and ruins paint finishes. Pair the RD-60 with the RS-37 for a complete dry-air package.

products.title: Ball Valve 2″ & Electric Actuator
products.excerpt: Full-bore stainless ball valve with a 24 V electric actuator.
products.specs:
Size: 2 in (DN50)
Pressure rating: PN40
Actuator: 24 V DC, 15 s
Body: stainless steel 316
Seats: PTFE
products.body: Remote open/close with position feedback. The actuator has a manual override for when the power is off.

products.title: Butterfly Valve BF-150
products.excerpt: Wafer butterfly valve DN150 with gear operator.
products.specs:
Size: DN150
Pressure rating: PN16
Operator: gearbox
Disc: ductile iron, nylon coated
Liner: EPDM
products.body: Light, compact and cheap to keep in stock. The standard choice for water mains and HVAC.

products.title: Gate Valve GV-100
products.excerpt: Resilient-seated gate valve for water and wastewater.
products.specs:
Size: DN100
Pressure rating: PN16
Stem: non-rising
Body: ductile iron, epoxy coated
Standard: EN 1171
products.body: Full bore when open, drop-tight when closed. Our municipal customers buy these by the pallet.

products.title: Swing Check Valve CV-80
products.excerpt: Swing check valve that stops backflow after the pump.
products.specs:
Size: DN80
Pressure rating: PN16
Disc: rubber-faced
Body: cast iron
Mounting: horizontal or vertical up
products.body: Fit one after every pump discharge. It costs far less than a reverse-spinning motor.

products.title: Pressure Relief Valve PR-25
products.excerpt: Spring-loaded relief valve, set and tagged in our workshop.
products.specs:
Size: 1 in
Set pressure: 2–16 bar
Body: bronze
Certification: PED
Test: certificate included
products.body: Every PR-25 leaves our workshop bench-tested and tagged with its set pressure and a test certificate.
